svg.aria-label: Consensus comes in many equivalent forms: if you can solve one, you can solve the others. Single-value consensus: all nodes decide the same value, such as who is leader. A shared log, also called total order broadcast: every node appends and sees entries in the same order. Fetch-and-add or compare-and-set on a linearizable register. Atomic commitment: all participants commit or all abort. Raft, Paxos and Zab implement these; ZooKeeper and etcd offer them as a service.
